name: Modern Insulators Ltd
about: Modern Insulators is an arm of the Modern group of Industries and was set up in 1985 in collaboration with Siemens, Germany. Modern Insulators is also India’s largest manufacturer and exporter of porcelain insulators and is closely associated with National and Regional Utilities, Indian Railways, OEMs & EPC companies worldwide.[1]
keyPoints:
Certification[1]
Modern is an ISO 9001, 14001 & 45001 Certified Company and also India’s largest exporter of porcelain insulators.

pros: Company is expected to give good quarter
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 2.74% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 7.79% over last 3 years.
